title: Bernie Young's band and the recordings
summary: They look at pictures of Bernie Young's band and talk about recordings, with Dave Kapp managing.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Did you ever see a picture of Bernie Young's band? Yeah.
I may have a picture of home. I'm included in it. It's a particular band, I don't know. I have one home in the band.
Did you see this with Half Fine?
Yeah, well I played with Half Fine too.
Have you got this album with all this stuff on it?
Yeah, it's got you in it.

Yeah, we recorded. The personnel of that band was George Mitchell, Bob Schauffman had charged the band, and myself, Dave Young, and Delbert Bright, and Kenneth Anderson, the saxophones, and Cass Simpson, piano, and John Frasier was the bass player. Yeah. We made a tune called Fifteen Centons. It's right here, I got it in there. Yeah, Snaggin' or something like that. I heard it. I did. Yeah, that's what it was, Fanning, yeah. Half Fine was a performer, he wasn't a musician. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah, Dave Kapp was managing at that time. We made a tune, but didn't make any money out of him, and went on to my hour.
